name: TMA-6

LightMin corrected from threshold to source light lower bound.
generalRisks: Subjective effects are presented as coming from user reports, and effects may be unpredictable; adverse effects may become more likely as the dose increases.
saferUse: The dose information is educational user and resource material, not a recommendation; check it independently.
summary: A rarely seen Psychedelic Amphetamine and Mescaline analogue. First synthesised by Alexander Shulgin, who descrived it as "one of the most rewarding and pleasurable of the methoxylated amphetamines."
